name: Chuck Grassley
stanceSummary: Track AIPAC (trackaipac.com/congress) reports an Israel Lobby Total of $1,310,549 for Chuck Grassley in U.S. Senate, IA. This candidate has taken funding from the Israel lobby.

timeline.event: Grassley criticized proposed restrictions on U.S. military aid to Israel and called for unwavering support.
